rnea_compensator_config._comment: SHARED default RNEA config for the SINGLE-sensor collection viz (find_bota_port opens the first Bota sensor; the hand is NOT resolved, so wrench_sign is UNVERIFIED for whatever sensor is attached — validate with a static tilt). The bimanual real_world viz uses per-side rnea_compensator_{left,right}.json instead. As with those, the UMI adapter zeroes geometry.imu_offset at runtime.

geometry._comment: sensor-origin -> IMU point [m], SENSOR axes. STANDALONE value; the UMI adapter zeroes this because the 12-vector IMU is already at the sensor origin (see _comment).

conventions._comment: wrench_sign copied from the left-hand calibration but UNVERIFIED for the sensor collection_viz actually opens — validate with a static tilt.
